channel.title: Santi Andrade / Blog
channel.description: Notes and reflections on artificial intelligence by Santi Andrade.

item.title: AI automations that know when to stay quiet
item.description: A useful automation does not need to announce every success. Here is how I design tasks that stay quiet when everything works, speak up when something changes and never mistake an error for no news.

item.title: How I built a second brain with Obsidian and Hermes
item.description: Why a collection of notes is not enough, and how an agent can turn it into living, traceable and useful knowledge.

item.title: From chatbot to companion: why I built my own AI agent with Hermes
item.description: What happens when AI stops living in a browser tab and starts remembering, using tools and helping in everyday life.
